title.zh: 卷八十六 列傳第十六: 耶律合住 劉景 劉六符 耶律褭履 牛溫舒 杜防 蕭和尚 耶律合里只 耶律頗的
title.en: Volume 86 Biographies 16: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Ye Luniaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang, Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode
title.raw: 卷八十六 列傳第十六: 耶律合住 劉景 劉六符 耶律褭履 牛溫舒 杜防 蕭和尚 耶律合里只 耶律頗的 Volume 86 Biographies 16: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Ye Luniaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang, Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode

sentences.zh: 耶律合住劉景劉六符耶律甗履牛溫舒杜防蕭和尚

translations.literal: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Yelu Lü, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Yelu Lü, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, and Xiao Heshang

sentences.zh: （特末）〉

translations.literal: (Temuo)]〉
translations.idiomatic: (Temuo)]〉

sentences.zh: 耶律合裏只耶律頗的

translations.literal: Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Helizhi and Yelu Pode

sentences.zh: 耶律合住，字粘袞，太祖弟叠剌之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Hezhu, style name Niangun, was a grandson of Taizu's younger brother Diela.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Hezhu, whose style name was Niangun, was a grandson of Diela, a younger brother of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 幼不好弄，臨事明敏，善談論。

translations.literal: As a child he did not care for play; in affairs he was bright and keen, and skilled in discourse.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he shunned idle play; in office he was quick and perceptive, and an able conversationalist.

sentences.zh: 初以近族入侍，每從征伐有功。

translations.literal: At first, as a close kinsman, he entered palace service and repeatedly followed campaigns with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered court service as a near kinsman of the throne and repeatedly distinguished himself on campaign.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，加右龍虎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: At the start of the Baoning era he was given the additional rank of General-in-Chief of the Right Dragon-Tiger Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era he received the additional post of General-in-Chief of the Right Dragon-Tiger Guards.

sentences.zh: 以宋師屢梗南邊，拜涿州刺史，西南兵馬都監、招安、巡檢等使，賜推忠奉國功臣。

translations.literal: Because Song forces repeatedly obstructed the southern frontier, he was appointed prefect of Zhuo, Southwest Military Commissioner, Pacification Commissioner, Patrol Commissioner, and the like, and granted the title Merit Subject of Loyalty and Service to the State.
translations.idiomatic: As Song armies repeatedly harassed the southern border, he was made prefect of Zhuo, Southwest Military Commissioner, and Pacification and Patrol Commissioner, among other posts, and granted the merit title Loyal and Faithful Servant of the State.

sentences.zh: 合住久任邊防，雖有克獲功，然務鎮靜，不妄生事以邀近功。

translations.literal: Hezhu long held frontier posts; though he had victories in capture, he nevertheless sought calm and did not rashly provoke incidents to win quick credit.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhu served long on the frontier. Though he won his share of victories, he kept the border calm and would not stir up trouble merely to win quick acclaim.

sentences.zh: 鄰壤敬畏，屬部乂安。

translations.literal: Neighboring lands held him in awe, and subordinate tribes were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring territories respected him, and the tribes under his charge lived in peace.

sentences.zh: 宋數遣人結歡，冀達和意，合住表聞其事，帝許議和。

translations.literal: Song repeatedly sent men to establish goodwill, hoping to convey a desire for peace; Hezhu memorialized the matter, and the emperor permitted talks of peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Song court repeatedly sent envoys to open friendly contact in hope of peace; Hezhu reported this to the throne, and the emperor agreed to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 安邊懷敵，多有力焉。

translations.literal: In securing the border and winning over foes, he contributed much.
translations.idiomatic: He did much to pacify the frontier and win over the enemy.

sentences.zh: 拜左金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Crow Guards.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Crow Guards.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，遙攝鎮國軍節度使，卒。

translations.literal: When his term ended he was given remote charge as Military Commissioner of the Zhenguo circuit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired he was given titular charge of the Zhenguo circuit as military commissioner, and soon after died.

sentences.zh: 合住智而有文，曉暢戎政。

translations.literal: Hezhu was intelligent and literate, and thoroughly understood military administration.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhu was both clever and learned, with a thorough grasp of frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 鎮范陽時，嘗領數騎徑詣雄州北門，與郡將立馬陳兩國利害，及周師侵邊本末。

translations.literal: While governing Fanyang, he once led a few horsemen straight to the north gate of Xiong Prefecture and, mounted beside the prefect, set forth the advantages and harms to both states and the whole course of the Zhou army's border invasion.
translations.idiomatic: While posted at Fanyang he once rode with only a few followers straight to the north gate of Xiong Prefecture, where he and the Song prefect, both on horseback, laid out the interests of the two states and the full story of the Zhou invasion of the borderlands.

sentences.zh: 辭氣慷慨，左右壯之。

translations.literal: His words were impassioned, and those beside him were stirred.
translations.idiomatic: His speech was bold and impassioned, and all who heard him were moved.

sentences.zh: 自是，邊境數年無事。

translations.literal: From then on the border was without incident for several years.
translations.idiomatic: After that the frontier remained quiet for several years.

sentences.zh: 識者以謂合住一言，賢於數十萬兵。

translations.literal: The knowing said that one word from Hezhu was worth more than several hundred thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Men of judgment held that a single speech by Hezhu was worth more than an army of hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 劉景，字可大，河間人。

translations.literal: Liu Jing, style name Keda, was a man of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jing, whose style name was Keda, came from Hejian.

sentences.zh: 四世祖怦，即朱滔之甥，唐右僕射、盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor Bing was a nephew of Zhu Tao of Tang, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Military Commissioner of the Lulong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His fourth-generation ancestor Bing was Zhu Tao's nephew and had served the Tang as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and military commissioner of Lulong.

sentences.zh: 父守敬，南京副留守。

translations.literal: His father Shoujing was Deputy Regent of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shoujing had been deputy regent of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 景資端厚，好學能文。

translations.literal: Jing's endowment was steady and substantial; he loved learning and could write.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was sober and upright by nature, fond of study, and skilled with the pen.

sentences.zh: 燕王趙延壽辟為幽都府文學。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Zhao Yanshou recruited him as Literary Officer of the Youdu Prefecture office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou, Prince of Yan, took him on as literary officer of the Youdu prefectural staff.

sentences.zh: 應歷初，遷右拾遺、知制誥，為翰林學士。

translations.literal: At the start of the Yingli era he was moved to Right Reminder, drafter of edicts, and made Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yingli reign he was promoted to Right Reminder and drafter of edicts, and appointed a Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 九年，周人侵燕，留守蕭思溫上急變，帝欲俟秋出師，景諫曰：「河北三關已陷於敵，今復侵燕，安可坐視！」

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Zhou invaded Yan; Regent Xiao Siwen reported the emergency. The emperor wished to wait until autumn to take the field. Jing remonstrated, saying, "The three passes of Hebei have already fallen to the enemy; now they invade Yan again—how can we sit and watch!
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Zhou attacked Yan. Regent Xiao Siwen reported the crisis, but the emperor wanted to wait until autumn before marching. Jing urged him, saying, "The three passes of Hebei have already fallen to the enemy, and now they invade Yan again—how can we simply look on!

sentences.zh: 上不聽。

translations.literal: The sovereign did not heed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 會父憂去。

translations.literal: He happened to leave office on his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: He then left office to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 未幾，起復舊職。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled from mourning to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled from mourning to his former post.

sentences.zh: 一日，召草赦，既成，留數月不出。

translations.literal: One day he was summoned to draft an amnesty; when it was finished, it was held back for months without issue.
translations.idiomatic: One day he was ordered to draft an amnesty edict; when it was finished, it was kept back for months without being promulgated.

sentences.zh: 景奏曰：「唐制，赦書日行五百里，今稽期弗發，非也。」

translations.literal: Jing memorialized, saying, "Under Tang regulations an amnesty edict travels five hundred li a day; now it is delayed and not issued—this is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Jing submitted a memorial, saying, "Under Tang practice an amnesty edict was to travel five hundred li a day; to hold it back now is wrong.

sentences.zh: 上亦不報。

translations.literal: The sovereign again gave no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Again the emperor made no response.

sentences.zh: 景宗即位，以景忠實，擢禮部侍郎，遷尚書、宣政殿學士。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, because Jing was loyal and solid he was promoted to Vice Minister of Rites and moved to Minister and Academician of the Xuanzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong came to the throne, Jing's integrity won him promotion to Vice Minister of Rites and then to Minister and academician of the Xuanzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 上方欲倚用，乃書其笏曰：「劉景可為宰相。」

translations.literal: The sovereign was about to rely on him heavily and wrote on his tablet, "Liu Jing can serve as chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was preparing to rely on him heavily and wrote on his court tablet, "Liu Jing is fit to be chief minister.

sentences.zh: 頃之，為南京副留守。

translations.literal: Before long he became Deputy Regent of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made deputy regent of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 時留守韓匡嗣因扈從北上，景與其子德讓共理京事。

translations.literal: At the time Regent Han Kuangsi had followed the court north; Jing and his son Derang jointly administered capital affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The regent Han Kuangsi had accompanied the court north, and Jing governed the capital together with Han's son Derang.

sentences.zh: 俄召為戶部使，歷武定、開遠二軍節度使。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as Commissioner of the Household Bureau and successively served as Military Commissioner of the Wuding and Kaiyuan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to serve as commissioner of the Household Bureau and later held military commissions in the Wuding and Kaiyuan circuits.

sentences.zh: 統和六年致仕，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tonghe he retired and was given the additional rank of Concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tonghe he retired from office and was given the additional rank of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十七。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太師。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 子慎行，孫一德、二玄、三嘏、四端、五常、六符，皆具六符傳。

translations.literal: His son was Shenxing; his grandsons were Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu—all are treated in the biography of Liufu.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Shenxing; his grandsons Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu are all covered in the following account of Liu Liufu.

sentences.zh: 劉六符，父慎行，由膳部員外郎累遷至北府宰相、監修國史。

translations.literal: Liu Liufu—his father Shenxing rose from Vice Director of the Board of Foodstuffs to Northern Chancellery Grand Councilor and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Liufu was the son of Shenxing, who had risen from vice director of the Board of Foodstuffs to grand councilor of the Northern Chancellery and supervisor of the national history.

sentences.zh: 時上多即宴飲行誅賞，慎行諫曰：「以喜怒加威福，恐未當。」

translations.literal: At the time the sovereign often pronounced executions and rewards at banquets. Shenxing remonstrated, saying, "To mete out authority and favor according to joy and anger—this is perhaps not fitting.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor often pronounced punishments and rewards while drinking at court. Shenxing urged him, saying, "To grant authority and favor according to mood is hardly proper.

sentences.zh: 帝悟，諭政府「自今宴飲有刑賞事，翌日稟行」。

translations.literal: The emperor understood and instructed the government, "From now on, whenever punishments or rewards arise at banquets, they are to be reported and carried out the next day."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the point and instructed the government that from then on any punishments or rewards decided at banquets were to be reported and carried out only on the following day.

sentences.zh: 為都統，伐高麗，以失軍期下吏，議貴乃免，出為彰武軍節度使。

translations.literal: As supreme commander he campaigned against Goryeo; for missing the army schedule he was handed to the officials, but after deliberation on his noble rank he was pardoned and sent out as Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: As supreme commander against Goryeo he missed the campaign schedule and was handed over to the courts; because of his noble rank the penalty was waived, and he was sent out as military commissioner of Zhangwu.

sentences.zh: 賜保節功臣。

translations.literal: He was granted the title Merit Subject of Preserving Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the merit title Preserver of Integrity.

sentences.zh: 子六人：一德、二玄、三嘏、四端、五常、六符。

translations.literal: He had six sons: Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu.
translations.idiomatic: He had six sons: Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu.

sentences.zh: 德早世。

translations.literal: Yide died young.
translations.idiomatic: Yide died young.

sentences.zh: 玄終上京留守。

translations.literal: Erxuan ended as Regent of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erxuan eventually became regent of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 常歷三司使、武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: Wuchang successively served as Commissioner of the Three Bureaus and Military Commissioner of the Wuding circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang served in turn as commissioner of the Three Bureaus and as military commissioner of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 嘏、端、符皆第進士。

translations.literal: Sangu, Siduan, and Liufu all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu, Siduan, and Liufu all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 嘏、端俱尚王，為駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Sangu and Siduan both married princesses and became Commandants of Escort.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu and Siduan both married imperial princesses and became commandants of escort.

sentences.zh: 三嘏獻聖宗《一矢斃雙鹿賦》，上嘉其贍麗。

translations.literal: Sangu presented to Emperor Shengzong the fu 《One Arrow Slays Two Deer》; the sovereign praised its richness and beauty.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu presented to Emperor Shengzong his fu 《One Arrow Slays Two Deer》, which the emperor praised for its richness and polish.

sentences.zh: 與公主不諧，奔宋；

translations.literal: He was not harmonious with the princess and fled to Song;
translations.idiomatic: He fell out with his princess and fled to Song;

sentences.zh: 歸，殺之。

translations.literal: when he returned, he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: when he returned he was put to death.

sentences.zh: 四端以衛尉少卿使宋賀生辰，方宴，大張女樂，竟席不顧，人憚其嚴。

translations.literal: Siduan, as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud, was envoy to Song to congratulate the emperor on his birthday. At the banquet Song greatly deployed female musicians, but he sat through the feast without looking—men feared his severity.
translations.idiomatic: Siduan went to Song as vice director of the Court of Imperial Stud to congratulate the emperor on his birthday. At the banquet the Song court set out a great display of female musicians, but he never once looked their way; all who saw him feared his sternness.

sentences.zh: 還，拜樞密直學士。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六符有誌操，能文。

translations.literal: Liufu had resolve and integrity and could write.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu was a man of principle and an able writer.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，遷政事舍人，擢翰林學士。

translations.literal: At the start of the Chongxi era he was moved to Administrative Drafting Attendant and promoted to Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he was made administrative drafting attendant and then promoted to Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 十一年，與宣徽使蕭特末使宋索十縣地；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, together with Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Xiao Temuo, he was envoy to Song to demand the ten counties;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he went with Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Xiao Temuo as envoy to Song to demand the return of ten counties;

sentences.zh: 還，為漢人行宮副部署。

translations.literal: on his return he became Deputy Commissioner of the Han Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: on his return he was made deputy commissioner of the Han palaces.

sentences.zh: 會宋遣使增歲幣以易十縣，復與耶律仁先使宋，定「進貢」名，宋難之。

translations.literal: When Song sent envoys to increase the annual tribute in exchange for the ten counties, he again went with Yelu Renxian as envoy to Song to fix the term "tribute presentation"; Song found this hard to accept.
translations.idiomatic: When Song sent envoys offering to increase the annual payments in exchange for the ten counties, he went again with Yelu Renxian to fix the term "tribute presentation," which the Song court resisted.

sentences.zh: 六符曰：「本朝兵強將勇，海內共知，人人願從事於宋。

translations.literal: Liufu said, "Our court's soldiers are strong and its generals brave—the whole realm knows this, and every man wishes to take service against Song.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu said, "Our dynasty's armies are strong and its generals brave—the whole world knows it, and every soldier would gladly march against Song.

sentences.zh: 若恣其俘獲以飽所欲，與『進貢』字孰多？

translations.literal: If they were allowed free rein in captives and plunder to satisfy their desires, how would that compare with the word 'tribute presentation'?
translations.idiomatic: If they were turned loose to take captives and booty to their hearts' content, how would that weigh against the word 'tribute'?

sentences.zh: 況大兵駐燕，萬一南進，何以禦之！

translations.literal: Moreover, with a great army stationed at Yan, if it should advance south by any chance, how could you resist it!
translations.idiomatic: And with a great army stationed at Yan, if it should march south, how would you withstand it!

sentences.zh: 顧小節，忘大患，悔將何及！」

translations.literal: To cling to a small point and forget a great peril—when regret comes, how will it be in time!
translations.idiomatic: To cling to a petty point and forget a grave danger—when regret comes, it will be too late!

sentences.zh: 宋乃從之，歲幣稱「貢」。

translations.literal: Song then yielded, and the annual payments were called "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: Song then yielded, and the annual payments were henceforth styled "tribute."

sentences.zh: 六符還，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: When Liufu returned he was given the additional rank of Associate Chief Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On his return Liufu was made associate chief councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 及宋幣至，命六符為三司使以受之。

translations.literal: When Song's payments arrived, Liufu was ordered to serve as Commissioner of the Three Bureaus to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song payments arrived, he was appointed commissioner of the Three Bureaus to receive them.

sentences.zh: 六符與參知政事杜防有隙，防以六符嘗受宋賂，白其事，出為長寧軍節度使，俄召為三司使。

translations.literal: Liufu and Vice Director of the Secretariat Du Fang were at odds; Fang reported that Liufu had once accepted bribes from Song. He was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Changning circuit, but soon recalled as Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu and Vice Director Du Fang were at odds; Fang reported that Liufu had once taken bribes from Song. He was sent out as military commissioner of Changning, but was soon recalled as commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 道宗即位，將行大冊禮，北院樞密使蕭革曰：「行大禮備儀物，必擇廣地，莫若黃川。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Daozong took the throne and was about to perform the great investiture rite, Northern Chancellery Military Affairs Commissioner Xiao Ge said, "To perform a great rite with full ritual objects, one must choose broad ground—none is better than Huangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong came to the throne and prepared the great investiture rite, Northern Chancellery Military Affairs Commissioner Xiao Ge said, "A great ceremony requires ample space and full ritual equipment—no place is better than Huangchuan.

sentences.zh: 六符曰：「不然。

translations.literal: Liufu said, "Not so.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu said, "That will not do.

sentences.zh: 禮儀國之大體，帝王之樂不奏於野。

translations.literal: Rites and etiquette are the great foundation of a state; the music of emperors is not performed in the wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual is the great foundation of a state; an emperor's music is not performed in the open countryside.

sentences.zh: 今中京四方之極，朝覲各得其所，宜中京行之。」

translations.literal: Now the Central Capital is the center of the four directions; audiences each find their proper place—there it should be performed.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Capital is the hub of the realm, where audiences from every quarter can be properly received—it should be held there.

sentences.zh: 上從其議。

translations.literal: The sovereign followed his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his view.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died of illness.

sentences.zh: 耶律履，字海鄰，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Lü, style name Hailin, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Lü, whose style name was Hailin, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Divisions.

sentences.zh: 風神爽秀，工於畫。

translations.literal: His bearing was bright and elegant, and he was skilled at painting.
translations.idiomatic: He was handsome and spirited, and a skilled painter.

sentences.zh: 重熙間，累遷同知點檢司事。

translations.literal: During the Chongxi era he was repeatedly promoted to Associate Director of the Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he rose to associate director of the Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉蕭胡睹為夏人所執，奉詔索之，三返以歸，轉永興宮使、右祗候郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: Commandant of Escort Xiao Huzhu was captured by the Tangut; by imperial order Lü sought his return, and after three journeys brought him back. He was transferred to Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace and detailed commander of the Right Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company.
translations.idiomatic: When Commandant of Escort Xiao Huzhu was captured by the Tangut, Lü was ordered to secure his release and brought him back after three missions. He was then made commissioner of the Yongxing Palace and detailed commander of the Right Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company.

sentences.zh: 履將娶秦晉長公主孫，其母與公主婢有隙，謂履曰：「能去婢，乃許爾婚。」

translations.literal: Lü was to marry a granddaughter of the Qin-Jin Senior Princess; her mother had a feud with a maid of the princess and told Lü, "If you can remove the maid, then your marriage will be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Lü was to marry a granddaughter of the Qin-Jin Senior Princess. The girl's mother bore a grudge against one of the princess's maids and told Lü, "Remove that maid, and I will consent to the marriage.

sentences.zh: 履以計殺之，婚成。

translations.literal: Lü killed her by a stratagem, and the marriage was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Lü contrived her death, and the marriage went ahead.

sentences.zh: 事覺，有司以大辟論。

translations.literal: When the affair came to light, the officials proposed the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair came to light, the courts sought the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 履善畫，寫聖宗真以獻，得減坐，長流邊戍。

translations.literal: Lü was skilled at painting; he painted a true likeness of Emperor Shengzong and presented it, thereby reducing his sentence, and was banished for life to frontier garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was a skilled painter, he painted a portrait of Emperor Shengzong and presented it, winning a reduced sentence and lifelong exile to the frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 復以寫真，召拜同知南院宣徽事。

translations.literal: Again through portraiture he was summoned and appointed Associate Commissioner of the Southern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was later recalled through his portraiture and appointed associate commissioner of the Southern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 使宋賀正，寫宋主容以歸。

translations.literal: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year, he painted the Song ruler's likeness and returned with it.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to Song to congratulate the New Year, he painted the Song emperor's likeness and brought it home.

sentences.zh: 清寧間，復使宋。

translations.literal: During the Qingning era he was again envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingning era he was again sent as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 宋主賜宴，瓶花隔面，未得其真。

translations.literal: The Song ruler gave a banquet; vase flowers blocked the face, and he did not obtain a true likeness.
translations.idiomatic: At a banquet given by the Song emperor, flowers in vases blocked his view, and he could not capture a true likeness.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，僅一視，及境，以像示餞者，駭其神妙。

translations.literal: At his farewell audience he glanced only once; when he reached the border he showed the portrait to those who saw him off, and they were awed by its divine subtlety.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience he had only a single glance; when he reached the border he showed the portrait to those who had come to see him off, and they marveled at its lifelike brilliance.

sentences.zh: 聞重元亂，不即勤王。

translations.literal: When he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, he did not hurry to aid the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, he did not hurry to the emperor's aid.

sentences.zh: 賊平入賀，帝責讓之。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified he entered to offer congratulations, and the emperor reproached him.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebels were crushed he came to offer congratulations, and the emperor rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 宴酣，顧履曰：「重元事成，卿必得為上客！」

translations.literal: When the banquet was merry, the emperor turned to Lü and said, "If Chongyuan's affair had succeeded, you would surely have been a chief guest!
translations.idiomatic: As the banquet grew lively, the emperor turned to Lü and said, "If Chongyuan had succeeded, you would surely have been his honored guest!

sentences.zh: 履大慚。

translations.literal: Lü was deeply ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: Lü was deeply ashamed.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，加太子太師，卒。

translations.literal: During the Xianyong era he was given the additional rank of Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianyong era he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and died.

sentences.zh: 牛溫舒，范陽人。

translations.literal: Niu Wenshu was a man of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Wenshu came from Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 剛正尚節義，有遠器。

translations.literal: Upright and firm, he honored integrity and righteousness and had far-reaching capacity.
translations.idiomatic: He was upright and principled, held integrity in high regard, and showed promise of great things.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，擢進士第，滯小官。

translations.literal: During the Xianyong era he passed the jinshi examination but remained stuck in minor posts.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianyong era he passed the jinshi examination but languished in minor posts.

sentences.zh: 大安初，累遷戶部使，轉給事中、知三司使事。

translations.literal: At the start of the Da'an era he was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Household Bureau, then moved to Supervising Secretary and Acting Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Da'an era he rose to commissioner of the Household Bureau, then became supervising secretary and acting commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 國民兼足，上以為能，加戶部侍郎，改三司使。

translations.literal: The state's people were all provided for; the sovereign considered him capable, gave him the additional rank of Vice Minister of the Household Bureau, and changed his post to Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm's people were well supplied, the emperor judged him capable, made him vice minister of the Household Bureau, and appointed him commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 壽隆中，拜參知政事，兼同知樞密院事，攝中京留守。

translations.literal: During the Shoulong era he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Acting Regent of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shoulong era he was made vice director of the Secretariat, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and acting regent of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 部民詣闕請真拜，從之。

translations.literal: The people of his circuit went to court to request his formal appointment, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of his jurisdiction petitioned the court for his formal appointment, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 召為三司使。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Commissioner of the Three Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as commissioner of the Three Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 乾統初，復參知政事，知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: At the start of the Qian Tong era he again became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Acting Director of Southern Chancellery Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qian Tong era he again became vice director of the Secretariat and director of Southern Chancellery military affairs.

sentences.zh: 五年，夏為宋所攻，來請和解。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Tangut were attacked by Song and came to request mediation for peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Tangut, attacked by Song, came to seek Liao's mediation for peace.

sentences.zh: 溫舒與蕭得裏底使宋。

translations.literal: Wenshu and Xiao Delidi were envoys to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Wenshu and Xiao Delidi were sent as envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 方大燕，優人為道士裝，索土泥藥爐。

translations.literal: At a great banquet, an actor dressed as a Daoist priest asked for earth to knead a medicine furnace.
translations.idiomatic: At a grand banquet an actor dressed as a Daoist priest asked for earth to knead into a medicine furnace.

sentences.zh: 優曰：「土少不能和。」

translations.literal: The actor said, "There is too little earth—it cannot be kneaded.
translations.idiomatic: The actor said, "There is too little earth to knead it properly.

sentences.zh: 溫舒遽起，以手藉土懷之。

translations.literal: Wenshu abruptly rose, took earth in his hands, and clasped it to his bosom.
translations.idiomatic: Wenshu rose at once, scooped up earth in his hands, and pressed it to his chest.

sentences.zh: 宋主問其故，溫舒對曰：「臣奉天子威命來和，若不從，則當卷土收去。」

translations.literal: The Song ruler asked the reason. Wenshu replied, "Your servant has come with the Son of Heaven's august mandate to make peace; if you do not agree, then I must roll up the earth and take it away.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song emperor asked why, Wenshu answered, "I have come with our emperor's mandate to make peace; if you refuse, I shall roll up this earth and carry it home.

sentences.zh: 宋人大驚，遂許夏和。

translations.literal: The Song were greatly alarmed and then agreed to peace with the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: The Song court was deeply alarmed and agreed to make peace with the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 還，加中書令，卒。

translations.literal: On his return he was given the additional rank of Director of the Secretariat and died.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made director of the Secretariat and soon died.

sentences.zh: 杜防，涿州歸義縣人。

translations.literal: Du Fang was a man of Guiyi County in Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fang came from Guiyi County in Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開泰五年，擢進士甲科，累遷起居郎、知制誥，人以為有宰相器。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kaitai he was selected in the top class of the jinshi examination, was repeatedly promoted to Court Diarist and drafter of edicts, and men considered him to have the makings of a chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Kaitai he passed the jinshi examination in the top class, rose to court diarist and drafter of edicts, and was widely regarded as chief-minister material.

sentences.zh: 太平中，遷政事舍人，拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: During the Taiping era he was moved to Administrative Drafting Attendant and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping era he became administrative drafting attendant and vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 重熙九年，夏人侵宋。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chongxi the Tangut invaded Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Chongxi the Tangut attacked Song.

sentences.zh: 宋遣郭稹來告，請與夏和，上命防使夏解之。

translations.literal: Song sent Guo Zhen to report and request peace with the Tangut; the sovereign ordered Fang to go to the Tangut to settle it.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Guo Zhen to report the crisis and ask for peace with the Tangut; the emperor ordered Fang to mediate with the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 如約罷兵，各歸侵地，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: As agreed, the armies were halted and each side returned the territory it had seized; he was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: As agreed, both sides halted hostilities and returned seized territory, and he was made vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 韓紹芳、劉六符忌之，防待以誠。

translations.literal: Han Shaofang and Liu Liufu were jealous of him, but Fang treated them with sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shaofang and Liu Liufu were jealous of him, yet Fang treated them with sincerity.

sentences.zh: 十二年，紹芳等罷，愈見信任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Shaofang and the others were dismissed, and he was ever more trusted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Shaofang and his faction were dismissed, and Fang won still greater trust.

sentences.zh: 十三年，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Grand Councilor of the Southern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was made grand councilor of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十五年，防生子，帝幸其第，賜名王門奴。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Fang had a son; the emperor visited his residence and bestowed the name Wangmennu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Fang had a son; the emperor visited his home and gave the child the name Wangmennu.

sentences.zh: 以進奏有誤，出為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: For an error in a memorial report he was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After an error in a memorial report he was sent out as military commissioner of Wuding.

sentences.zh: 十七年，復召為南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was again summoned as Grand Councilor of the Southern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was recalled as grand councilor of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二十一年秋，祭仁德皇后，詔儒臣賦詩，防為冠，賜金帶。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-first year, at the sacrifice for Empress Rend, the court ordered Confucian officials to compose poems; Fang's was foremost, and he was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-first year, at the rites for Empress Rend, the court ordered scholar-officials to compose poems; Fang's ranked first, and he was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 道宗諒陰，為大行皇帝山陵使。

translations.literal: During Emperor Daozong's mourning for his father, he served as commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Daozong's mourning for his father, he served as commissioner for the late emperor's tomb.

sentences.zh: 清寧二年，上諭防曰：「朕以卿年老嗜酒，不欲煩以劇務。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingning the sovereign instructed Fang, saying, "Because you are old and fond of wine, I do not wish to burden you with heavy duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingning the emperor told Fang, "You are old and fond of wine, and I do not wish to burden you with heavy duties.

sentences.zh: 朝廷之事，總綱而已。」

translations.literal: In court affairs, hold only the general lines.
translations.idiomatic: In court affairs you need only hold the general lines.

sentences.zh: 頃之，拜右丞相，加尚父，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Right Chief Councilor, given the title Exalted Father, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made right chief councilor and honored as Exalted Father, then died.

sentences.zh: 上嘆悼不已，赗贈加等，官給葬具，贈中書令，謚曰元肅。

translations.literal: The sovereign lamented without end, increased the funeral gifts, supplied burial goods from the state, posthumously made him Director of the Secretariat, and gave the posthumous title Yuansu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him deeply, increased the funeral gifts, supplied state burial goods, posthumously made him director of the Secretariat, and gave him the posthumous title Yuansu.

sentences.zh: 子公謂，終南府宰相。

translations.literal: His son Gongwei ended as Grand Councilor of the Southern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gongwei eventually became grand councilor of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 蕭和尚，字洪寧，國舅大父房之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Heshang, style name Hongning, was a descendant of the Great-Grandfather Branch of the Imperial Maternal Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Heshang, whose style name was Hongning, came from the Great-Grandfather Branch of the imperial maternal clan.

sentences.zh: 忠直，多智略。

translations.literal: He was loyal and upright, with many stratagems.
translations.idiomatic: He was loyal, upright, and full of stratagem.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，補禦盞郎君，尋為內史、太醫等局都林牙。

translations.literal: At the start of Kaitai he was appointed Cupbearer Attendant; soon he became Chief Secretary of the Inner History, Imperial Medical Service, and other bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaitai he entered service as cupbearer attendant and soon became chief secretary of the Inner History, Imperial Medical Service, and related bureaus.

sentences.zh: 使宋賀正，將宴，典儀者告，班節度使下。

translations.literal: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year, when a banquet was about to be held the master of ceremonies announced that his place would rank below military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to Song to congratulate the New Year, he was told before the banquet that he would be seated below military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 和尚曰：「班次如此，是不以大國之使相禮。

translations.literal: Heshang said, "If the seating is thus, this is not to treat an envoy of a great state with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Heshang said, "Such seating does not treat an envoy of a great power with proper courtesy.

sentences.zh: 且以錦服為貺，如待蕃部。

translations.literal: Moreover, to give brocade robes as gifts is like treating a frontier tribe.
translations.idiomatic: And to offer brocade robes as gifts is to treat us like a frontier tribe.

sentences.zh: 若果如是，吾不預宴。」

translations.literal: If it is truly so, I will not take part in the banquet.
translations.idiomatic: If that is truly the case, I will not attend the banquet.

sentences.zh: 宋臣不能對，賜以紫服，位視執政，使禮始定。

translations.literal: Song officials could not reply; he was granted purple robes and a seat equal to chief ministers, and envoy protocol was then fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The Song officials had no answer; he was granted purple robes and a seat equal to the chief ministers, and envoy protocol was settled.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，為唐古部節度使，卒。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year he became Military Commissioner of the Tangut Tribes and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year he was made military commissioner of the Tangut tribes and died.

sentences.zh: 弟特末。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Temuo.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Temuo.

sentences.zh: 特末，字何寧。

translations.literal: Temuo, style name Haning.
translations.idiomatic: Temuo, whose style name was Haning.

sentences.zh: 為人機辨任氣。

translations.literal: As a man he was quick-witted and bold-spirited.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick-witted, bold, and self-willed.

sentences.zh: 太平中，累遷安東軍節度使，有能稱。

translations.literal: During the Taiping era he was repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of the Andong circuit and had a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping era he rose to military commissioner of Andong and won a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 十一年，召為左祗候郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was summoned as detailed commander of the Left Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was recalled as detailed commander of the Left Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷左夷離畢。

translations.literal: Before long he was moved to Left yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made left yilibi.

sentences.zh: 重熙十年，累遷北院宣徽使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chongxi he was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Chongxi he rose to commissioner of the Northern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 明年，與劉六符使宋，索十縣故地，宋請增銀、絹十萬兩、匹以易之。

translations.literal: The next year, with Liu Liufu as envoy to Song, he demanded the ten counties of former territory; Song asked to increase silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he went with Liu Liufu to Song to demand the return of ten former counties; Song offered to increase the annual payments of silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts in exchange.

sentences.zh: 歸，稱旨，加同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: On his return he pleased the sovereign and was given the additional rank of Associate Chief Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he pleased the emperor and was made associate chief councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 詔城西南渾底甸。

translations.literal: He was ordered to build a city at Hundidian in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to build a city at Hundidian in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 還，復為北院宣徽使，卒。

translations.literal: On his return he again became Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery Palace Secretariat and died.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he again served as commissioner of the Northern Chancellery Palace Secretariat and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律合裏只，字特滿，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Helizhi, style name Teman, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Helizhi, whose style name was Teman, was a descendant of Puguzhi, yilijin of the Six Divisions.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，累遷西南面招討都監。

translations.literal: During the Chongxi era he was repeatedly promoted to Southwest Pacification and Suppression Commissioner-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he rose to southwest pacification and suppression commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 充宋國生辰使，館於白溝驛。

translations.literal: Serving as envoy to Song for the emperor's birthday, he lodged at the Baigou post station.
translations.idiomatic: As envoy to Song for the emperor's birthday, he lodged at the Baigou post station.

sentences.zh: 宋宴勞，優者嘲蕭惠河西之敗。

translations.literal: At Song's banquet in his honor, an actor mocked Xiao Hui's defeat west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: At the banquet held in his honor, an actor mocked Xiao Hui's defeat on the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 合裏只曰：「勝負兵家常事。

translations.literal: Helizhi said, "Victory and defeat are common matters in warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Helizhi said, "Victory and defeat are common in war.

sentences.zh: 我嗣聖皇帝俘石重貴，至今興中有石家寨。

translations.literal: Our Emperor Shizong captured Shi Chonggui; to this day in Xingzhong there is a Shijia Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Our Emperor Shizong took Shi Chonggui prisoner, and to this day Xingzhong has a Shijia Stockade to prove it.

sentences.zh: 惠之一敗，何足較哉！」

translations.literal: What is one defeat of Hui's to compare!
translations.idiomatic: What is one defeat of Hui's beside that!

sentences.zh: 宋人慚服。

translations.literal: The Song were ashamed and convinced.
translations.idiomatic: The Song were silenced and impressed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之曰：「優令失辭，何可傷兩國交好！」

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he said, "The actor's lines were improper—how could they harm the friendship of the two states!
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it he said, "The actor spoke out of turn—how could that be allowed to harm relations between our two states!

sentences.zh: 鞭二百，免官。

translations.literal: He was given two hundred lashes and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The actor was given two hundred lashes and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，起為懷化軍節度使。

translations.literal: At the start of Qingning he was recalled to serve as Military Commissioner of the Huaihua circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qingning he was recalled as military commissioner of Huaihua.

sentences.zh: 七年，入為北院大王，封豳國公。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he entered court as Great King of the Northern Chancellery and was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he entered court as great king of the Northern Chancellery and was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 歷遼興軍節度使、東北路詳穩，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: He successively served as Military Commissioner of the Liaoxing circuit and detailed commander of the Northeast Route, and was given the additional rank of Concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as military commissioner of Liaoxing and detailed commander of the northeast route, and was given the additional rank of palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 合裏只明達勤恪，懷柔有道。

translations.literal: Helizhi was clear-sighted, diligent, and reverent, and had the way of winning people by kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Helizhi was clear-minded, diligent, and skilled in winning people through kindness.

sentences.zh: 置諸賓館及西邊營田，皆自合裏只發之。

translations.literal: The establishment of guesthouses and western frontier garrison farms all originated with Helizhi.
translations.idiomatic: The guesthouses and western frontier garrison farms were all established on his initiative.

sentences.zh: 耶律頗的，字撒版，季父房奴瓜之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Pode, style name Saban, was a grandson of Nugua of the Shufu branch.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Pode, whose style name was Saban, was a grandson of Nugua of the Shufu branch.

sentences.zh: 孤介寡合。

translations.literal: He was aloof and solitary, keeping little company.
translations.idiomatic: He was aloof by nature and kept little company.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，補牌印郎君。

translations.literal: At the start of Chongxi he was appointed Seal and Tablet Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongxi he entered service as seal and tablet attendant.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，稍遷知易州。

translations.literal: At the start of Qingning he was gradually promoted to prefect of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qingning he was promoted to prefect of Yi.

sentences.zh: 去官，部民請留，許之。

translations.literal: When he left office the people of his circuit asked that he remain, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When he left office the people of his jurisdiction petitioned to keep him, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 咸雍八年，改彰國軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianyong he was transferred as Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianyong he was transferred as military commissioner of Zhangguo.

sentences.zh: 上獵大牢古山，頗的謁於行宮。

translations.literal: When the sovereign hunted at Mount Dalaogu, Pode presented himself at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor hunted on Mount Dalaogu, Pode presented himself at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 帝問邊事，對曰：「自應州南境至天池，皆我耕牧之地。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about frontier affairs. He replied, "From the southern border of Ying Prefecture to Heaven Pool, all is our land for farming and grazing.
translations.idiomatic: Asked about frontier affairs, he replied, "From the southern border of Ying Prefecture to Heaven Pool, all is our land for farming and grazing.

sentences.zh: 清寧間，邊將不謹，為宋所侵，烽堠內移，似非所宜。」

translations.literal: During Qingning the frontier generals were not careful; Song encroached, and beacon towers were moved inward—this seems not fitting.
translations.idiomatic: During Qingning our frontier commanders were careless; Song encroached, and our beacon towers were pulled back inland—which seems unwise.

sentences.zh: 道宗然之。

translations.literal: Emperor Daozong approved of this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daozong agreed.

sentences.zh: 拜北面林牙。

translations.literal: He was appointed Northern Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed northern secretary.

sentences.zh: 後遣人使宋，得其侵地，命頗的往定疆界。

translations.literal: Later an envoy was sent to Song and recovered the encroached territory; Pode was ordered to go fix the border.
translations.idiomatic: Later an envoy to Song recovered the seized territory, and Pode was ordered to go demarcate the border.

sentences.zh: 還，拜南院宣徽使。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Commissioner of the Southern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made commissioner of the Southern Chancellery Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大康四年，遷忠順軍節度使，尋為南院大王，改同知南京留守事，召拜南府宰相，賜貞良功臣，封吳國公，為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dakang he was transferred as Military Commissioner of the Zhongshun circuit; soon he became Great King of the Southern Chancellery, was changed to Associate Regent of the Southern Capital, summoned as Grand Councilor of the Southern Chancellery, granted the title Merit Subject of Integrity, enfeoffed as Duke of Wu, and made Military Affairs Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dakang he was made military commissioner of Zhongshun; soon he became great king of the Southern Chancellery, associate regent of the Southern Capital, and grand councilor of the Southern Chancellery, was granted the merit title of Integrity, enfeoffed as Duke of Wu, and appointed military affairs commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 廉謹奉公，知無不為。

translations.literal: Incorrupt and careful in serving the public, he did whatever he knew should be done.
translations.idiomatic: He was incorrupt, conscientious in public service, and did whatever duty required.

sentences.zh: 大安中致仕，卒。

translations.literal: During the Da'an era he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired during the Da'an era and died.

sentences.zh: 子霞抹，北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: His son Xiamo became Vice Military Affairs Commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiamo became vice military affairs commissioner of the Northern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 論曰：耶律合住安邊講好，養兵息民，其慮深遠矣。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Yelu Hezhu secured the border and sought peace, nourished the army and gave the people rest—his forethought was far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: Yelu Hezhu secured the frontier and pursued peace, kept the army in readiness while giving the people rest—his foresight ran deep.

sentences.zh: 六符啟釁邀功，豈國家之利哉？

translations.literal: Liufu stirred strife to win merit—was this to the state's advantage?
translations.idiomatic: Liufu stirred up conflict to win credit—what advantage was that to the state?

sentences.zh: 牛、杜、頗的、合裏只輩銜命出使，幸不辱命。

translations.literal: Niu, Du, Pode, Helizhi, and their like bore imperial commissions abroad and, fortunately, did not disgrace their missions.
translations.idiomatic: Niu, Du, Pode, Helizhi, and men of their stamp went abroad on imperial commission and, fortunately, did not disgrace their missions.

sentences.zh: 裏殺人婢以求婚，身負罪釁，畫其主容，以冀免死，亦可醜也。

translations.literal: Lü killed a maid to obtain a marriage; bearing a capital crime, he painted his sovereign's likeness hoping to escape death—this too is shameful.
translations.idiomatic: Lü murdered a maid to secure a marriage; stained with a capital crime, he painted his sovereign's portrait in hope of escaping death—a shameful affair indeed.
